adversarial_findings_resolved: A full synthetic Q matrix with zero terminal receipts is reported as discordant.
A scored row without a matching declared terminal artifact digest or status is reported.
A third rating without explicit incident decisions or after impossible declared chronology is rejected.
Decimal JSON literals that round across the Q component cap or the >10-point arbitration trigger are rejected; judges assign integer component points.
Consumption or service declarations dated before their supporting lot, flow, or outcome are rejected.
Mass residuals at very different scales are checked with exact fractions, and extreme numeric JSON receives a structured error.
Incompatible published FAO loads cannot be spliced into one observed lot path.
